name: Kosovo

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2022: 1773971 inhabitants. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, read through the dissemination API. Kosovo carries no row more recent than 2022 in that dataset, so this is the latest published figure it offers, not a current one. The year field carries that and must be read with the value: the figure is sourced, it is simply 4 years old. The previous value was an opening estimate made with no source and no research. A national statistical office would give something fresher and has not been opened here.

Searched on 2026-07-27, in Albanian, in the transversal venues pass. One, and it is disputed on vocation rather than on existence. Teatri Dodona in Prishtina was founded on 12 November 1986 by decision of the municipal assembly, under the name Teatri i të rinjve, fëmijëve dhe i kukullave — the theatre of youth, children and puppets. Its own encyclopedia entry says it runs a puppet theatre with an acting ensemble and has staged more than thirty-three puppet premieres, and OpenStreetMap carries the building as Teatri i Pupetave Dodona, on Rruga Xhelal Mitrovica in the quarter the theatre gave its name to. Recorded as a stage rather than a house, and the distinction is the whole difficulty: Dodona is not an organisation whose vocation is puppetry, it is a youth and children's theatre with a puppetry line inside it, which is why the puppetry is the unit and Dodona is the parent. That reading sits one step away from the case Hungary's Kolibri and Croatia's Osijek settled the other way — a public children's theatre playing puppetry with one mixed company is not a puppetry unit. What keeps Dodona in is that its puppet line is named, continuous and separately counted, where Kolibri's was none of the three. It stays disputed until the theatre's own site is read for a puppetry ensemble distinct from the acting one.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Faculty of Arts of the University of Pristina, the only public institution in the field, runs three departments, visual arts, musical arts and dramatic arts, the last opened in 1989-90 with an acting stream and now counting eight undergraduate profiles. No puppetry profile was identified. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1: the eight profiles were not enumerated at source and one of them could fall within the field. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. venues: read Teatri Dodona's own site. The question that decides between 1 and 0 is narrow — does the puppetry line hold puppeteers of its own, or is it the acting ensemble playing with puppets? The second answer puts Kosovo where Hungary put Kolibri.
